summary: Dispatches a race standings/championship status audio message: when the race is active and the track condition is initialized, initializes a driver table entry buffer, computes a driver index (queried from the standings sort buffer, plus one, but only in championship mode 4, otherwise -1), computes a message ID via sub_420000, populates the entry with DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion, and inserts it into the shared driver data table via InsertDriverTableEntry.

operations.description: Outer guard: proceed only when dword_7D0308 (race active) is non-zero AND flt_7CF3C8 (track condition) is not equal to 0.0; otherwise the whole dispatch is skipped.
Call StructInitWithSentinelValues(v3) to initialize the local driver-table entry buffer with sentinel/default values.
Seed v0 with the default sentinel value -1 before the championship-mode check.
Guard on dword_7D0410 (championship mode) equal to 4; only then is a real driver index computed.
Query the standings sort buffer dword_7D2DB0 via sub_4C2990 and add 1 to convert the returned position into v0.
Move the computed index v0 into v2, the position argument passed to the table lookup.
Call sub_420000() and store its return as v1, the message ID argument.
Call DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion(v3, v1, v2, -1, -1, -1, -2.0, -2.0) to populate the entry with the computed message ID and position plus sentinel arguments.
Call InsertDriverTableEntry(flt_5EA618, v3) to push the populated entry into the shared driver data table.
Implicit return; function returns void after the guarded dispatch completes or the outer guard fails.

unresolved: Meaning of the sentinel arguments -1, -1, -1 and -2.0, -2.0 passed to DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion is not derivable from this function alone.
Semantics of championship mode value 4 and the +1 adjustment on the sub_4C2990 result are caller- and data-dependent.
Exact purpose and return semantics of sub_420000 (message ID) require that function's own analysis.
Why a driver index is only supplied in championship mode 4 and what the -1 default represents (no position) is unverified.
Relation of the caller sub_40DE60 and the frame path that reaches this dispatcher is not established.
